excerpt: AI finds those posts on X. You show up with the right reply.

Post allowances cover discovery and product listening. Matches depend on real conversations, not a guaranteed lead count.
Each website needs its own subscription. Usage resets on the first of each UTC calendar month. Subscription renewal follows your billing date.

A few things to know.

Can I try it before paying?+

Eligible X accounts can try one website for 48 hours without a card: up to 150 posts screened and 3 AI reply drafts. Screened posts are not guaranteed matches. Trial places are limited. Saved results stay available when your trial ends, and you choose whether to subscribe.

What does the AI do for me?+

It reads your website, builds editable intent phrases, finds relevant posts and explains why they fit. Open a match and it writes a short, first-person reply in the original post’s language, with your product link.

How do I send a reply?+

Review or edit the draft. Publish reply copies the text, opens the original X post in a new tab and marks it handled. Paste and send it on X.

Do I need to keep the dashboard open?+

No. Discovery runs in the background during your free trial or active subscription. Results appear as they are found. Your trial stops when its time or search allowance is used; subscribing keeps discovery running within your plan.

Can I add another website?+

Yes. Each website has its own subscription, search settings and usage budget. Add it from your workspace switcher. Deleting a website stops renewal and removes its results, without a refund.
